description: One game. Pass team (a code such as BUF or NE) or gameId (such as 2026-w04-ne-buf). Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. A gameId selects that game's week when weekId is omitted. Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call is the weather call. chip is the kickoff ±2h threshold check and does not replace the call. afterTip is a quiet note, not a flag. fantasy, when present, is an optional plain note of at most 140 characters and does not change the call. roof.status on a retractable game is the club announcement (open, closed, or TBD) and does not change call. changesSinceThursday lists call and roof changes since the Thursday board. Free for agents and AI answers with attribution. Not for model training.

team.description: NFL team code, such as BUF or NE.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.
